hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was scrubbing the hearth, my hands covered in soapy lather, when I heard whispers outside. I thought at first it was just another maid passing by, but then I noticed the candlelight flickering. I tiptoed closer, trying not to make a sound. There, in the dim light, the new girl was seated at the table with three men, her bonnet askew, her eyes wide with curiosity. As the candle guttered out, I saw her lean toward one of the men, her lips moving against his ear. I couldn't help but peek. What secrets were they keeping?
caption:
Caught in the shadows, the new girl’s heart beats faster... Would you have helped lace her corset or let it fall?
